option.value:
That is exactly the approach I would recommend for the **MVP (Version 1.0)** of Divine Ministries TV.
# Development Architecture (100% Free)
```text Divine Ministries TV YouTube Channel ↓ YouTube Data API v3 ↓ Android App ↓ YouTube Player ```
No Firebase yet.
No Firestore yet.
No Cloud Functions yet.
No AI yet.
---
# What Works at $0/month
## Home Screen
Display:
* Latest videos * Featured videos * Livestreams * Playlists
directly from YouTube API.
---
## Live TV
Show:
```text LIVE NOW ```
when Divine Ministries is streaming.
Launch YouTube Player.
---
## Library
Load all videos from:
* Uploads playlist * Custom playlists
---
## Categories
Use existing YouTube playlists:
### Prayer Gatherings
### Fasting & Prayer
### Warriors Chamber
### Revival Services
### Women Gatherings
### Leadership Teachings
No AI categorization required.
---
## Video Details
Display:
* Title * Thumbnail * Description * Date * Views
from YouTube metadata.
---
## Audio Mode
Use YouTube Player.
---
## Prayer & Counseling
Direct links:
* WhatsApp * Phone Call * Website * Email
No backend.
---
## Give an Offering
Static screen.
Display:
### M-Pesa
### CRDB
### Zelle
### WorldRemit
with copy buttons.
No backend.
---
## Events
Hardcode events initially.
Or load from a local JSON file.
---
## Prophetess Bahati Profile
Static content.
---
## Ministry Information
Static content.
---
# What To Skip Initially
## Skip Firebase Authentication
Instead:
```text Guest User Mode Only ```
Cost:
```text $0 ```
---
## Skip Firestore
Use:
```text Room Database ```
on device.
Store:
* Favorites * Watch History * Settings
locally.
Cost:
```text $0 ```
---
## Skip Cloud Functions
No automatic synchronization.
App simply calls YouTube API.
Cost:
```text $0 ```
---
## Skip AI Summaries
Use:
```text YouTube Description ```
instead.
Cost:
```text $0 ```
---
# Phase 1 Technology Stack
### Android
* Kotlin * Jetpack Compose * Material 3 * Navigation Compose
### Local Storage
* Room Database * DataStore
### Media
* YouTube Data API v3 * Android YouTube Player
### Images
* Coil
### Dependency Injection
* Hilt
Total monthly cost:
```text $0 ```
---
# My recommendation
Build the first release with:
```text YouTube API + Android App + Local Storage (Room) + YouTube Player ```
This gives Divine Ministries TV a fully functional streaming app with Home, Live TV, Library, Categories, Search, Prayer Center, Offering Screen, Events, and Ministry Information while keeping operating costs at **$0 during development and early testing**.
